response.text: Hello. Your goal is to process partnership requests by reading new emails in your "Partners" Gmail label, summarizing them with an AI model, and adding them to Airtable with sender, company, request type, a 2-sentence summary, and a priority flag, while routing low-confidence items for human review. My plan to achieve this is: 1. Conduct a kickoff and requirements review for Gmail and Airtable schema alignment. 2. Develop the script to read new emails from the "Partners" Gmail label using Python and the Gmail API. 3. Integrate AI summarization to extract the required data fields. I did nearly this for a small support team: About 300 emails a week sorted into 6 categories; low-confidence ones go to a person. What specific fields are currently set up in your Airtable base for the partnership requests? Let us discuss the full plan in chat.
